designs.title: Security Baseline
designs.heading: Security Baseline
items: Root object validated for null pointers?
Sensitive data encrypted at rest and in-memory?
CI runners are isolated and hardened?
No untrusted build steps or scripts?
Have Selenium or UI testing in CI/CD pipeline?
UI state cannot be manipulated to bypass server validation?
Are all protocols of secure version?
No sensitive data in error logs?
Are using production grade hardened baseline image?
Has code been validated against race conditions?
Are security sensitive changes flagged post production?
Session tokens use secure, HttpOnly and Same Site flags?
Has code been manually reviewed by experienced pentester?
CI/CD performed to test environment prior to production before every deploy?
JWT Claims validated? (role, iss, aud, exp, nbf, alg)
Using secure version of random number generator?
Memory containing secrets zeroed after reuse?
Key access is audited and logged?
Partial failures do not expose sensitive state?
All configuration settings checked and reviewed?
Secrets can be rotated without redployment?
Risk playbooks exist and are readily accesible?
Inputs from internal services treated as untrusted?
Memory cleared and pointers released if no garbage collector?
Utilizing constructors and destructors as possible?
Test data does not contain production secrets?
Are you meeting privacy by design (GDPR/CCPA)?
Cookies policy, Privacy Policy, and Terms & Conditions pages on site?
Has legal reviewed User Interface Text and Design?
Has cost anomolies and cloud increased cost protection?
A/B testing for UI and new production builds? With percentage on new not all traffic?
